verses.original: δὲ Ἐγένοντο καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐν τῷ λαῷ καὶ ὡς ἔσονται ψευδοδιδάσκαλοι ἐν ὑμῖν οἵτινες παρεισάξουσιν ἀπωλείας αἱρέσεις καὶ ἀρνούμενοι τὸν δεσπότην ἀγοράσαντα αὐτοὺς ἐπάγοντες ταχινὴν ἀπώλειαν ἑαυτοῖς
verses.transliteration: de Egenonto kai pseudoprophētai en tō laō kai hōs esontai pseudodidaskaloi en hymin hoitines pareisaxousin apōleias haireseis kai arnoumenoi ton despotēn agorasanta autous epagontes tachinēn apōleian heautois
verses.literal: Now there were also false prophets among the people just as there will be false teachers among you [They] will secretly introduce destructive heresies even denying the Master who bought them bringing swift destruction on themselves

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὶ ἐξακολουθήσουσιν αὐτῶν ταῖς ἀσελγείαις δι’ οὓς ἡ ὁδὸς τῆς ἀληθείας βλασφημηθήσεται
verses.transliteration: kai polloi exakolouthēsousin autōn tais aselgeiais di’ hous hē hodos tēs alētheias blasphēmēthēsetai
verses.literal: - Many will follow in their - depravity [and] because of [them] the way of truth will be defamed

verses.original: καὶ ἐν πλεονεξίᾳ ἐμπορεύσονται ὑμᾶς πλαστοῖς λόγοις τὸ ἔκπαλαι κρίμα οἷς οὐκ ἀργεῖ καὶ αὐτῶν ἡ ἀπώλεια οὐ νυστάζει
verses.transliteration: kai en pleonexia emporeusontai hymas plastois logois to ekpalai krima hois ouk argei kai autōn hē apōleia ou nystazei
verses.literal: - In their greed [these false teachers] will exploit you with deceptive words The longstanding verdict against them vvv remains in force and their - destruction {does} not sleep

verses.original: γὰρ Εἰ ὁ Θεὸς οὐκ ἐφείσατο ἀγγέλων ἁμαρτησάντων ἀλλὰ ταρταρώσας παρέδωκεν σειραῖς ζόφου τηρουμένους εἰς κρίσιν
verses.transliteration: gar Ei ho Theos ouk epheisato angelōn hamartēsantōn alla tartarōsas paredōken seirais zophou tēroumenous eis krisin
verses.literal: For if - God {did} not spare [the] angels when they sinned but cast [them] deep into hell placing [them] in chains of darkness to be held for judgment

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἐφείσατο ἀρχαίου κόσμου ἐπάξας κατακλυσμὸν κόσμῳ ἀσεβῶν ἀλλὰ ἐφύλαξεν Νῶε κήρυκα δικαιοσύνης ὄγδοον
verses.transliteration: kai ouk epheisato archaiou kosmou epaxas kataklysmon kosmō asebōn alla ephylaxen Nōe kēryka dikaiosynēs ogdoon
verses.literal: [if] vvv He did not spare [the] ancient world when He brought [the] flood [on its] ungodly [people] but preserved Noah a preacher of righteousness among the eight

verses.original: καὶ κατέκρινεν πόλεις Σοδόμων καὶ Γομόρρας καταστροφῇ τεφρώσας τεθεικώς ὑπόδειγμα μελλόντων ἀσεβέσιν
verses.transliteration: kai katekrinen poleis Sodomōn kai Gomorras katastrophē tephrōsas tetheikōs hypodeigma mellontōn asebesin
verses.literal: [if] He condemned [the] cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction reducing [them] to ashes [as] an example of what is coming on the ungodly

verses.original: καὶ ἐρρύσατο Λὼτ δίκαιον καταπονούμενον ὑπὸ τῆς ἐν ἀσελγείᾳ ἀναστροφῆς τῶν ἀθέσμων
verses.transliteration: kai errysato Lōt dikaion kataponoumenon hypo tēs en aselgeia anastrophēs tōn athesmōn
verses.literal: and [if] He rescued Lot a righteous [man] distressed by the vvv depraved conduct of the lawless

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ δίκαιος ἐνκατοικῶν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας ἐβασάνιζεν δικαίαν ψυχὴν ἀνόμοις ἔργοις βλέμματι καὶ ἀκοῇ
verses.transliteration: gar ho dikaios enkatoikōn en autois hēmeran ex hēmeras ebasanizen dikaian psychēn anomois ergois blemmati kai akoē
verses.literal: (for that righteous [man] living among them day after day was tormented [in his] righteous soul [by the] lawless deeds he saw and heard

verses.original: Κύριος οἶδεν ῥύεσθαι εὐσεβεῖς ἐκ πειρασμοῦ δὲ τηρεῖν ἀδίκους κολαζομένους εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως
verses.transliteration: Kyrios oiden rhyesthai eusebeis ek peirasmou de tērein adikous kolazomenous eis hēmeran kriseōs
verses.literal: [ if all this is so, then the ] Lord knows how to rescue [the] godly from trials and to hold [the] unrighteous for punishment on [the] day of judgment

verses.original: δὲ μάλιστα τοὺς πορευομένους ἐν μιασμοῦ ἐπιθυμίᾳ ὀπίσω σαρκὸς καὶ καταφρονοῦντας κυριότητος τολμηταὶ αὐθάδεις οὐ τρέμουσιν βλασφημοῦντες δόξας
verses.transliteration: de malista tous poreuomenous en miasmou epithymia opisō sarkos kai kataphronountas kyriotētos tolmētai authadeis ou tremousin blasphēmountes doxas
verses.literal: [ Such punishment is ] specially [reserved] for those who indulge . . . [the] corrupt desires of [the] flesh and despise authority Bold [and] self-willed vvv they are unafraid to slander glorious beings

verses.original: ὅπου οὐ ἄγγελοι ὄντες μείζονες ἰσχύϊ καὶ δυνάμει φέρουσιν βλάσφημον κρίσιν κατ’ αὐτῶν παρὰ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: hopou ou angeloi ontes meizones ischui kai dynamei pherousin blasphēmon krisin kat’ autōn para Kyriō
verses.literal: Yet not even . . . angels [though] greater in strength and power dare to bring such slanderous charges against them before [the] Lord

verses.original: δέ Οὗτοι ὡς ἄλογα ζῷα φυσικὰ γεγεννημένα εἰς ἅλωσιν καὶ φθοράν βλασφημοῦντες ἐν οἷς ἀγνοοῦσιν ἐν αὐτῶν τῇ φθορᾷ καὶ φθαρήσονται
verses.transliteration: de Houtoi hōs aloga zōa physika gegennēmena eis halōsin kai phthoran blasphēmountes en hois agnoousin en autōn tē phthora kai phtharēsontai
verses.literal: - These [men] [are] like irrational animals creatures of instinct born - to be captured and destroyed They blaspheme in [matters] they do not understand [and like such creatures] . . . . . . . . . vvv they too will be destroyed

verses.original: ἀδικούμενοι μισθὸν ἀδικίας ἡγούμενοι ἡδονὴν τὴν τρυφήν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ σπίλοι καὶ μῶμοι ἐντρυφῶντες ἐν αὐτῶν ταῖς ἀπάταις συνευωχούμενοι ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: adikoumenoi misthon adikias hēgoumenoi hēdonēn tēn tryphēn en hēmera spiloi kai mōmoi entryphōntes en autōn tais apatais syneuōchoumenoi hymin
verses.literal: The harm they will suffer [is the] wages of [their] wickedness They consider it a pleasure - to carouse in broad daylight [They are] blots and blemishes reveling in their - deception as they feast with you

verses.original: ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχοντες μεστοὺς μοιχαλίδος καὶ ἀκαταπαύστους ἁμαρτίας δελεάζοντες ἀστηρίκτους ψυχὰς κατάρας τέκνα ἔχοντες καρδίαν γεγυμνασμένην πλεονεξίας
verses.transliteration: ophthalmous echontes mestous moichalidos kai akatapaustous hamartias deleazontes astēriktous psychas kataras tekna echontes kardian gegymnasmenēn pleonexias
verses.literal: [Their] eyes are full of adultery - their desire for sin is never satisfied . . . they seduce [the] unstable . . . [They are] accursed children with hearts trained in greed

verses.original: Καταλιπόντες εὐθεῖαν ὁδὸν ἐπλανήθησαν ἐξακολουθήσαντες τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ Βαλαὰμ τοῦ Βεώρ ὃς ἠγάπησεν μισθὸν ἀδικίας
verses.transliteration: Katalipontes eutheian hodon eplanēthēsan exakolouthēsantes tē hodō tou Balaam tou Beōr hos ēgapēsen misthon adikias
verses.literal: They have left [the] straight way and wandered off to follow the way - of Balaam - [son] of Beor who loved [the] wages of wickedness

verses.original: δὲ ἔσχεν ἔλεγξιν ἰδίας παρανομίας ὑποζύγιον ἄφωνον φθεγξάμενον ἐν ἀνθρώπου φωνῇ ἐκώλυσεν τοῦ προφήτου τὴν παραφρονίαν
verses.transliteration: de eschen elenxin idias paranomias hypozygion aphōnon phthenxamenon en anthrōpou phōnē ekōlysen tou prophētou tēn paraphronian
verses.literal: But he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey [ otherwise ] without speech that spoke with a man’s voice [and] restrained the prophet’s - madness

verses.original: Οὗτοί εἰσιν πηγαὶ ἄνυδροι καὶ ὁμίχλαι ἐλαυνόμεναι ὑπὸ λαίλαπος ζόφος τοῦ σκότους τετήρηται οἷς ὁ
verses.transliteration: Houtoi eisin pēgai anydroi kai homichlai elaunomenai hypo lailapos zophos tou skotous tetērētai hois ho
verses.literal: These [men] are springs without water and mists driven by a storm Blackest - darkness is reserved for them -

verses.original: γὰρ ὑπέρογκα ματαιότητος φθεγγόμενοι ἀσελγείαις ἐπιθυμίαις σαρκὸς δελεάζουσιν ἐν τοὺς ὀλίγως ἀποφεύγοντας τοὺς ἀναστρεφομένους ἐν πλάνῃ
verses.transliteration: gar hyperonka mataiotētos phthengomenoi aselgeiais epithymiais sarkos deleazousin en tous oligōs apopheugontas tous anastrephomenous en planē
verses.literal: - With lofty [but] empty words, they appeal [to the] sensual passions of [the] flesh [and] entice - those [who are] just escaping from [others] who live in error

verses.original: ἐπαγγελλόμενοι αὐτοῖς ἐλευθερίαν αὐτοὶ ὑπάρχοντες δοῦλοι τῆς φθορᾶς γάρ τούτῳ καὶ δεδούλωται ᾧ τις ἥττηται
verses.transliteration: epangellomenoi autois eleutherian autoi hyparchontes douloi tēs phthoras gar toutō kai dedoulōtai hō tis hēttētai
verses.literal: They promise them freedom while they themselves are slaves - to depravity For vvv vvv a man is a slave to whatever vvv has mastered him

verses.original: Εἰ γὰρ ἀποφυγόντες τὰ μιάσματα τοῦ κόσμου ἐν ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ Σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δὲ ἐμπλακέντες ἡττῶνται τούτοις πάλιν αὐτοῖς ἔσχατα γέγονεν χείρονα τὰ τῶν πρώτων
verses.transliteration: Ei gar apophygontes ta miasmata tou kosmou en epignōsei tou Kyriou kai Sōtēros Iēsou Christou de emplakentes hēttōntai toutois palin autois eschata gegonen cheirona ta tōn prōtōn
verses.literal: If indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through [the] knowledge of [our] Lord and Savior Jesus Christ only to be entangled [and] overcome by it again their final [condition] is worse than - [it was] at first

verses.original: γὰρ ἦν κρεῖττον αὐτοῖς μὴ ἐπεγνωκέναι τὴν ὁδὸν τῆς δικαιοσύνης ἢ ἐπιγνοῦσιν ὑποστρέψαι ἐκ τῆς ἁγίας ἐντολῆς παραδοθείσης αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: gar ēn kreitton autois mē epegnōkenai tēn hodon tēs dikaiosynēs ē epignousin hypostrepsai ek tēs hagias entolēs paradotheisēs autois
verses.literal: - It would have been better for them not to have known the way - of righteousness than to have known [it] and then to turn away from the holy commandment passed on to them

verses.original: αὐτοῖς τὸ τῆς παροιμίας συμβέβηκεν ἀληθοῦς Κύων ἐπιστρέψας ἐπὶ τὸ ἴδιον ἐξέραμα καί Ὗς λουσαμένη εἰς κυλισμὸν βορβόρου
verses.transliteration: autois to tēs paroimias symbebēken alēthous Kyōn epistrepsas epi to idion exerama kai Hys lousamenē eis kylismon borborou
verses.literal: Of them the - proverbs are true A dog returns to - [its] vomit and A sow that is washed [goes back] to [her] wallowing in [the] mud
